data.name: Sudhir
data.gender_notes: Sudhir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Sudhir means 'having good conduct'. It is derived from the Sanskrit word 'sudh' which means 'pure' and 'hir' meaning 'conduct'. In Hindu mythology, Sudhir is a name given to virtuous and wise individuals. The name Sudhir carries the meaning “Good conduct, virtuous” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Sudhir usually hope their child will grow to embody good conduct, virtuous and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Sudhir belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Good conduct, virtuous.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Sudhir total 7, giving a life-path number of 7. Number 7 is linked with Ketu and with the qualities of reflection, wisdom and inner depth.
